notes: The whole image is 1669 by 2149 pixels. Half a is 1669 by 1154 and covers the text; half b is 1669 by 1155 and is blank apart from the lower-left archive number. Half b corresponds to whole-image y=994 through 2148. All reported bounding boxes use the whole image.

Two body paragraphs occupy the upper portion of a typescript. There is one slanted marginal example, no standalone displayed equation, and no mathematical diagram. The connected curve below ceux is a graphic insertion mark and is drawn in the transcription.

The page begins with the continuation nier. No preceding page was consulted. The only visible number on the sheet is the lower-left archive 19, preserved as a comment; no separate authorial page number, date or title beyond Cas principal. was found.

The first paragraph states that the relevant unipotents have the form exp(e) for e in g(2)*+Fil^3(g), describes a P-conjugacy class, and describes the U-conjugacy classes by the indicated sets. This is a statement read from the page, not a theorem verified here.

The second paragraph discusses the principal case, a Borel parabolic, a unit Z_o and Dyn_c as a G-torsor. The condition before (1)=0 and the interval before G are physically blank. H's editorial suggestion of an expected g is not adopted.

The author first writes sans doute in the Borel converse parenthesis and cancels it, leaving the following comma live and adding no new uncertainty there. The final la réciproque n'étant pas vraie sans doute remains live. The explicit NB mais pas par U also remains unchanged.

The margin gives A_2 and A_4 as examples and says the associated parabolics of sous-réguliers are Borels/borels, with an exclamation mark. No colon follows A_4. The note is written uphill to the right and is reproduced in a slanted five-line TikZ arrangement.

The handwritten g following a in the last formula is heavily retraced. Its left component is thicker than the other occurrences, but no independent different predecessor letter is securely recoverable. Handwriting weight is not treated as typewriter double striking.

The full page and every line of half a were read, including all C/H agreements, punctuation, accents, exponents, parentheses, quotation signs, underlining, ordinary capitals and cancellation states. Half b was read for any further material. No OCR, web source, other-page image, other reader, root decision, or optional compilation was used.

The completed reading.tex was saved before this report. The curved first cell of la is deliberately rendered as a tentative visible form plus graphic trace; its companion glyph is not promoted to a definite deleted predecessor.
